description.en: One of the sheikhs of the tribes in the Arabian desert of Iraq.

transliteration.ar-Latn-x-alalc: Thuwaynī b. ʿAbdullāh b. Muḥammad b. Māniʿ, from Āl Shubayyib, tracing his lineage to al-Ḥasan b. ʿAlī

tr: Sübeyni b. Abdullâh b. Muhammed b. Mâni', Âl-i Şubeyb'dendir, nesebi Hasan b. Ali'ye irtikâl eder.
ar: ثويني بن عبد الله بن محمد بن مانع، من آل شبيب، يرفع نسبه إلى الحسينالسبط
